title: Edmonton, here I come — starting my Ph.D. at UAlberta!
description: It's official — Ph.D. in Computer Science at UAlberta, starting January 2027. Now to survive my first Canadian winter.

title: We made the TikTok TechJam Grand Finals!
description: Our shopping copilot ARC reached the Grand Finals of TikTok TechJam 2026 — top 12 of 600+ teams, after three sleepless days.

title: Made the Dean's List at NUS :)
description: Dean's List at the School of Computing (top 5%) — a nice reward for a semester that did not feel nice at all.

title: ForestLLM, my work from my Microsoft internship, is out!!
description: ForestLLM is on arXiv! Turns out you can let an LLM design a random forest and then never call it again at test time.

title: The Rakuten offer came through — new chapter!
description: Joined Rakuten Asia to work on reasoning-augmented product search. Teaching a model to ask the right question is harder than it sounds.

title: NUS said yes — off to Singapore for my Master's!
description: The NUS offer came through, so I'm back in Singapore — this time for an M.Sc. in Computer Science.

title: Off to Beijing — I'm joining MSRA!
description: Research internship with the DKI group at MSRA, on LLMs for few-shot tabular learning. Excited, and a little terrified.

title: Wrapped up my time at 4Paradigm
description: Six months as an Applied Scientist on recommender systems and LLM post-training — my first look at ML with real users attached.

title: ADFound got accepted by IEEE JBHI!
description: ADFound was accepted by the IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics. I read the email about four times to make sure.

title: Starting my first full-time job at 4Paradigm
description: Applied Scientist in Shanghai, on recommender systems and LLM post-training. First real job, first real production system.

title: Graduated from Shandong University!
description: B.Eng. in Software Engineering, ranked 3rd out of 96. Time to find out what the real world wants.

title: Landed in Singapore — research attachment at A*STAR
description: SIPGA attachment at I²R, on uncertainty-based image-quality assessment for industrial defect detection. My first look at Singapore.

title: Off to Hong Kong — visiting student at PolyU!
description: A semester at PolyU on multimodal medical imaging for Alzheimer's disease — where the ADFound work began.

title: Got the SIPGA award from A*STAR!
description: Selected for the Singapore International Pre-Graduate Award, with a research attachment at A*STAR in the new year.
